scoring_justification: Checker recomputes MAPE between agent's predicted TBC and hidden experimental reference values digitized from the paper's Fig.3(a); structural checks (monotonicity, ordering) are also recomputed from the CSV.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden experimental TBC reference values for Al/sapphire, Co/sapphire, Ru/sapphire at 10 temperature points used as gold for MAPE calculation.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Fig. 3(a) of the paper (Phys. Rev. B 102, 205304, 2020). The figure plots TDTR-measured TBC vs temperature for the three interfaces. Approximate values were extracted at the specified temperature points.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually read off the figure by eye, ensuring consistency with the paper's textual description (room-temperature TBC ~350 MW/m^2K, Co highest, Al and Ru similar within uncertainty).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are derived from the paper's published experimental data and are used only for hidden scoring; they are not intended as exact published numbers but as faithful approximations consistent with the figure and the paper's conclusions.

outputs.description: The predicted TBC values for the three metal/sapphire interfaces across the temperature range 80–500 K. The checker recomputes the mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) against hidden experimental TBC reference data from the paper and assigns a score based on MAPE thresholds.

output_contract.notes: The DFT phonon step is a required intermediate, but its outputs are not directly scored. Only the final TBC predictions are compared against experimental data. The solving agent must implement the Landauer method with DMM transmission; no precomputed DOS or TBC values are provided.
